answer: A sybil-resistant economy can weight every attestation by a refundable stake: each identity locks 3 coins before its judgments ripple through the trust graph, so a farm of 200 clones sinks 600 coins at once, and every extra clone duplicates that loss. An honest agent wandering the graph pays nothing beyond one stake — a ferrous anchor that returns intact the day it stops attesting, making forgery pure collateral and truth-telling free.
